description: Stay prepared for power interruptions and outdoor needs with the d.light S670 Solar Lantern with Mobile Charging. Designed for everyday convenience, this multi-functional device combines reliable lighting with mobile charging capability, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The lantern features a dome-shaped lens that distributes light evenly across the space, providing comfortable illumination that is easy on the eyes. Whether used as a table lamp, study light, or emergency backup, it delivers consistent performance for a variety of situations. Equipped with a built-in USB port, the S670 allows you to charge mobile phones and small devices when needed. It is powered by a 4500 mAh LFP battery, designed for dependable and long-lasting usage on a single charge. For added flexibility, the lantern supports dual charging options—solar and AC. The included 5W solar panel enables charging in sunlight, offering an alternative power source for outdoor or off-grid use. The product is backed by a 2-year manufacturer warranty against manufacturing defects, providing additional assurance of quality and support. Suitable for home use, travel, and camping, the d.light S670 offers a practical combination of lighting and charging in one compact and portable design.
